body:
v0 is built. Read VOCABULARY.md first, then pkgs/zmx/wrapper.sh. The store is the reasoning behind them; it is not a description of the code.

WHAT EXISTS
pkgs/zmx/wrapper.sh — three rewrites, then the real binary. pkgs/zmx/default.nix — substitutes the binary's absolute path. tests/run-tests.sh with two pure-shell stubs — 23 argv cases. justfile — `just test`, `just lint`. emacs/dl-zmx.el — rewritten on the wrapper. flake.nix — overlay, packages, two checks, devshell. README.md — both install routes and the escape hatches.

VERIFIED IN THE JAIL
- `just test`: 23/23. `just lint`: shellcheck clean.
- A real-binary smoke test — the wrapper sed-substituted against zmx 0.8.1 with a scratch ZMX_DIR: a fresh dotted run wrote project/id and ended state=done; a failing dispatch exited 1 and wrote state=failed; an undotted run wrote no project; a session relabelled by hand kept its labels.

NOT VERIFIED — A HOST OWNS THESE
- `nix flake check`: there is no nix in the jail. The package, the overlay and the two checks have never been built.
- The elisp: there is no emacs in the jail. ert needs `emacs -Q --batch -L emacs`.
- Durability: there is no user systemd. Attach, close the terminal, reattach; restart the WM or emacs.service, reattach.
- The interactive attach path: there is no TTY, so only its argv is asserted.

WHAT CHANGED, AND WHY
c-wrapper-limits was read literally, so the wrapper checks existence by listing before it will label anything. Two smaller calls went in favour of less magic: a name whose project or id sanitises away is refused (exit 2) rather than retargeted, which makes a leading dot an empty project; and a detached run leaves state=working, because the work has not returned. e-wrapper-probes records the probes behind all of it, d-shadow-names the one correction.

WHAT IS STILL OPEN
Nothing designed. The next real decision is whether `blocked` gets a writer on the pi-zmx side, which is that harness's business, not this repo's.
title: Handoff: v0 is built
